meta.name: financial-reporting-and-close
meta.description: Runs the period-end close and produces reporting — close calendar, reconciliations, accruals, variance analysis, and reporting that gets read. Use this to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, investigate a variance, structure management reporting, or work out why the numbers keep changing after close.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成月度结账,并输出财务报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每月月底需要手工对账出报表,还常被数字对不上困扰。
copy.tagline_en: Automate your month-end close and produce reliable financial reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend late nights on manual reconciliations and the numbers keep shifting.

howto.what: 装上后，它会按流程带你完成期末结算：设定结算日历、安排对账与计提、分析差异，并产出直接可读的报告，同时提醒你守住硬性截止日。
howto.when: 当你想缩短或稳定月度结算、设计结算清单、调查差异等时，它会按结算流程接管任务。

say.text: 帮我把月度结算压缩到三天内，列出关键路径。
say.note: 它会按依赖关系重排任务并设置硬性截止日。

say.text: 分析本月销售费用差异，说明对比基准。
say.note: 它会先确认是预算、上期还是预测，再解释变动。

say.text: 为什么结算后数字还在变？怎么查？
say.note: 它会检查未清理的对账差异和截止日执行情况。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through the period-end close as a process: set the close calendar, schedule reconciliations and accruals, analyze variances, and produce a report that gets read, while enforcing a hard cutoff.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, investigate a variance, or understand why numbers keep changing after close.

say_en.text: Help me compress the month-end close to three days, showing the critical path.
say_en.note: It will re-sequence tasks by dependencies and set a hard cutoff.

say_en.text: Analyze this month's sales expense variance and state the baseline.
say_en.note: It will clarify the comparison base first, then explain changes.

say_en.text: Why do the numbers keep changing after close? How do I investigate?
say_en.note: It checks unresolved reconciling items and cutoff adherence.
